methods.geometrySelection: Raw counts include all instance records; active LOD0 = (flags & 0x8)==0 and lodIndex<=0; higher LOD = active and lodIndex>0; inactive = (flags & 0x8)!=0.
methods.triangles: Approximate source triangle count = manifest mesh idxCount/3. Unique-mesh sum is shown separately from instance-weighted LOD0 estimate. UE may drop source-degenerate triangles; for comparison the prior measured Root1 and Root3 UE triangle totals are in coverageBaseline.
methods.bounds: For each active LOD0 mesh, scan local mesh vertices to obtain local AABB; transform its 8 corners through the row-major instance affine; union in Atlas world metres. Conservative AABB, not oriented bounds or visual/game collision proof.
methods.proximity: Nearest pair uses transformed per-instance AABBs, via AuditRootAdjacency.py nearest-pair BVH. Non-decal distances exclude names matching /decal/i on both roots. Distance 0 means AABB overlap/touch; it does not prove a connected walkable passage.
methods.materials: Current opaque-master heuristic: role=opaque, alphaMode=OPAQUE, albedo+normal+doubleSided present; no vp/detail/parallax/emissive/glassTRS. Compatibility indicator only, not visual validation.
methods.colliderAssociation: Compare colliders.json rows to colliders.bin by row index after the same affine axis/sign conversion as AtlasEftAddSectorCollisionsCommandlet; exact root-name association to unique manifest.roots string, then validate collider level against all levels used by that root's geometry. This is root/layer association, not 1:1 collider-to-render-instance linkage.
methods.blockers: Current AtlasEftAddSectorCollisions policy counts non-trigger rows on LowPolyCollider, DoorLowPolyCollider, TransparentCollider, Interactive, LevelBorder, Terrain, Default; highpoly, Triggers layer, and all trigger-flagged records are not blockers. Convex mesh blocker rows are candidates but unsupported by the current complex-as-simple path.

secondaryDatasets.rootIdPresence: Lights/decal/navigation/volume/gameplay sidecars are per-level or map-level; they do not provide a reliable RootId for every record.
